video-db-skills-video-clips.description: Cut clips and highlights from a video. Use when the user wants a clip of a time range, a highlight reel of the moments that match a prompt ("every product demo", "the goals in this match"), a supercut across several videos, a vertical or square cut for Shorts, Reels or TikTok, a thumbnail, or an MP4 to download. One moment found by what was said is video-search, which also cuts that clip; joining whole videos with transitions is video-edit. Works on YouTube links, public URLs and the user's VideoDB videos.

video-db-skills-video-edit.description: Edit and compose video on a timeline. Use when the user wants to add background music, a voiceover or another audio track, put text, a logo or an image overlay on a video, join several videos or images into one with fades or other transitions, add animated or word-by-word karaoke captions, change the resolution or aspect ratio of a composition, or generate music, voiceover, images or video with AI for a composition. Static subtitles with a chosen font and position belong to video-subtitles.

video-db-skills-video-live.description: Live video and screen recording. Use when the user wants to connect a camera or live stream (RTSP, RTMP, HLS), watch it for an event and get alerted, search or play back what a stream showed, join and record a Zoom, Google Meet or Teams meeting that is happening now, or record their desktop screen and audio and get a summary or searchable timeline of that session. A recording that already exists as a file is a normal video: use video-search to ask about it.

video-db-skills-video-search.description: Find a moment in a video or ask a question about it. Use when the user wants to search inside a video, a library, or a meeting recording ("find where they talk about pricing", "which scenes show a phone", "what did she say about hiring"), get an answer with timestamps, count what appears, or get a clip of that moment. A highlight reel from a prompt, a cut by time range, or a vertical cut is video-clips. Works on YouTube links, public URLs and the user's VideoDB videos.

video-db-skills-video-subtitles.description: Subtitles, captions and transcripts for a video or audio file. Use when the user wants a transcript (plain or timestamped) of a video, podcast or call recording, static subtitles burned in with a chosen font, colour and position, a transcript or subtitles translated into another language, or dubbing. Animated or karaoke captions belong to video-edit. Works on YouTube links, public video URLs, audio files and media already in the user's VideoDB account.

video-db-skills-python.description: Set up VideoDB and write code against the VideoDB Python SDK. Use for "setup videodb" or "/videodb setup", when the user wants Python code, a script or a notebook rather than a chat answer, for bulk uploading or indexing a folder or library of media, for sandbox compute with open-weight models, and for any video task that video-search, video-clips, video-subtitles, video-edit and video-live do not cover. Screen recording belongs to video-live, AI-generated music, voiceover, images or video to video-edit, and dubbing to video-subtitles.
